summary: Visual regression + routes check for the illustration-glitch fix (frameBus/FrameDriver/visibility gating/sceneFrame/idleMount/Reveal/Lenis). Scrolled the Home page in 15 step positions (0->10000px) plus 6 mid-flight smooth scrolls, then back to top; also navigated Home->Pricing->Home. Across every captured frame the 3D illustrations stay CONTAINED inside their iso3d-host cards (workflow 4 feature cards, HowItWorks step panel, Vision three-layers, Platform cloud, three outcome mini-scenes, A-prompt-vs-Fluxvex pair, final affiliate flow). No ghost illustration appeared in sections without a card (hero, ROI calc, pricing preview, FAQ, footer). After nav away and back, the shared SceneCanvas parent is visibility:hidden at rest (correct gating behavior), confirming no leftover WebGL pixels. All 12 routes (/, /pricing, /contact, /security, /partners, /team, /blog, /integrations, /careers, /privacy, /terms, /admin/jobs) returned HTTP 200. Only console errors are two 401s on /admin/jobs auth session probe (expected when unauthenticated); the rest are benign THREE/WebGL perf warnings (KHR_parallel_shader_compile not supported, GL_CLOSE_PATH_NV ReadPixels GPU stall, THREE.Clock deprecation).

issues: Privacy choices cookie banner centered mid-viewport overlaps hero CTA area; consider positioning bottom-right or dismissing on scroll to avoid obscuring content during the first-visit journey (minor UX)

critical_code_review_comments: frameBus/FrameDriver ordering (lenis.raf -> gsap.ticker emitPostScrollFrame -> SceneCanvas advance) is the correct fix for the one-frame scroll-lag; keep the ticker-callback ordering immutable in App.js. A regression here will re-introduce the illustration-outside-card bug.

Canvas parent being visibility:hidden at rest (verified) is the right secondary safety net — leaves no stale pixels when loop pauses. Keep the paint-gate reveal gated on a fresh frame rather than on time.
Two console warnings worth cleaning: 'container has a non-static position' (one scene-host wrapper lacks relative/absolute); and THREE.Clock deprecation (switch to THREE.Timer at your convenience).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Illustration-outside-card bug confirmed fixed on 1440x900. 14 iso3d-host elements, canvas parent correctly visibility:hidden when no scene is on-screen. Routes all 200. If future work touches App.js ScrollManager or SceneCanvas FrameDriver, re-run multi-depth scroll screenshot test (positions 0,400,800,1400,2000,2800,3600,4400,5200,6000,6800,7600,8400,9200,10000) and also mid-flight smooth-scroll captures to catch any re-introduction of the one-frame draw lag.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: shared fixed WebGL canvas drew each frame BEFORE Lenis applied scroll, leaving every 3D illustration one scroll-step (up to 450px) behind its card during flings. Fix verified visually: frameloop='never' on canvas + FrameDriver advances it from gsap.ticker callback registered AFTER lenis.raf in App.js, so paint and DOM scroll land on the same frame. Visibility counter double-release was fixed in Scene3D.jsx; canvas layer is also hidden when loop is idle (parentVisibility='hidden' observed at every rest-state capture).
